description: Pinned old/current Import API compatibility drill over one current PostgreSQL schema. It proves only the session issuance, session resolution, account-fence and authenticated read-route entry slice. It must not be relabeled as full rolling-backend, persisted-state, parser-artifact or production compatibility.
requiredAssertions: the pinned old backend builds from its exact commit
the current backend builds from the exact source commit
the complete current migration sequence is applied before either backend starts
both old and current processes run concurrently against the same current PostgreSQL schema
an old-backend-issued session is resolved by the current backend
a current-backend-issued session is resolved by the old backend
account epoch fencing succeeds before the bounded missing-resource response
two active session rows exist without token disclosure
raw tokens are never committed to evidence
forbiddenClaims: full old backend new schema compatibility
limitations: session issuance, session resolution, account fencing and read-route entry only
not mixed persisted Preview or parser artifact coverage
